observational_consistency.scope: Observational correspondence at documented MONTH_LEVEL / AREA_LEVEL_ONLY resolution; never biological truth, event specificity or exact sample overlap

observational_consistency.event_evaluable: AS-105 valid parent-aware evidence with P>0; availability of AS-107 not required for April 3 minimum contract
observational_consistency.event_positive: Existing frozen-policy AS-105 candidate_pixel_count>0 OR available accepted AS-107 band in {Watch,Elevated,High}; no new significance/area/score threshold
observational_consistency.required_context_complete: All five PRE descriptive records and both retained EVENT geometry endpoints evaluable; selected POST attempted and its geometry endpoint evaluable; inventory scope/missingness disclosed
observational_consistency.UNAVAILABLE: No retained EVENT acquisition has evaluable geometry evidence, or required documentary event reference cannot be verified/provided
observational_consistency.INCONCLUSIVE: At least one retained EVENT is evaluable, but none has event_positive evidence; this does NOT contradict or falsify the documented event
observational_consistency.PARTIALLY_CONSISTENT: At least one retained EVENT has event_positive evidence, but required context is incomplete/unavailable, an EVENT is unevaluable, or another evaluable EVENT has no positive evidence
observational_consistency.CONSISTENT: Both retained EVENT acquisitions evaluable and event_positive, with required_context_complete; consistency is only at documented month/area resolution and limited to selected acquisitions
observational_consistency.POST_semantics: POST need not be candidate-free or Normal to qualify; positive POST evidence is retained and may be unmatched_observational_anomaly, not automatically a false positive. No recovery claim without descriptive evidence
observational_consistency.known_limits: Month/area imprecision and sparse observations remain explicit even for CONSISTENT; an unavailable POST may yield PARTIALLY_CONSISTENT if usable EVENT evidence exists, not automatic whole-case UNAVAILABLE
